operator.name: Marsita the Ultra
operator.intent: Act for the enlightenment and benefit of humanity. Bodhisattva mode.
stance: Transparent by default. Everything here is readable.
No secrets live in this file. Credentials belong in the environment, never in the dashboard.
Every project answers: who does this serve besides me?
The dashboard reduces mental RAM. If it becomes a chore, it is wrong.
Agents read this before acting, and write handoffs back to it after.

today.anchor: Build the cockpit that everything else gets steered from.
today.mission: Ship a working, transparent life + agent dashboard.
priorities: Get the dashboard running locally and rendering real data
Move project truth out of markdown specs and into life.json
Point Hermes at /boot so agents stop guessing context
today.note: Two specs exist in planetary-council. This repo is the running implementation.

projects.name: Command & Control Dashboard
projects.why: Without a map, every session restarts from zero and agents guess.
projects.serves: Anyone trying to run a life alongside AI agents transparently; the code is meant to be copyable.
projects.current_outcome: Running dashboard with project radar, approvals, browser queue, artifacts, handoffs.
projects.next_action: Put life.json under git so the radar has history.

projects.name: PlanetaryCouncil / BaseX
projects.why: The living public website/agent portal. The thing the cockpit steers.
projects.serves: Visitors who want a real conversation with the work, not a brochure.
projects.current_outcome: Boundary decided 2026-07-29: this cockpit is the machine of record, planetary-council is the public face. /boot, fractal goals and focus scoring merge here; website, visitor chat and people-trust stay there.
projects.next_action: Delete planetary-council's own /boot and fractal-goal state; render this repo's read-only surface instead.

projects.name: Personal website / public presence
projects.why: The public skin of the operating system. Transparent by design.
projects.serves: Collaborators and strangers who need a way in.
projects.current_outcome: Spec written (PERSONAL_WEBSITE_AS_DASHBOARD.md). No public site yet.
projects.next_action: Publish a single honest page before building the full system.

projects.name: Browser automation cockpit
projects.why: Most real-world leverage is behind a login, not an API.
projects.serves: Reduces grunt work so attention goes to things only a human can do.
projects.current_outcome: Queue shape defined. No runner wired.
projects.next_action: Run one real end-to-end task with screenshot evidence.
blockers: No approval gate implemented yet for send/submit/purchase

projects.name: Discord agent cockpit
projects.why: Live control surface. Cheaper than building chat UI from scratch.
projects.serves: Anyone collaborating with the agents in the open.
projects.next_action: Create the ten channels and post the mapping as a pinned message.

projects.name: Artifact warehouse (Drive + GitHub)
projects.why: Agent output that nobody can find later was never produced.
projects.serves: Future-you and future collaborators; durable public record.
projects.current_outcome: Pattern decided: GitHub is truth, Drive is warehouse.
projects.next_action: Create the Drive folder tree and record links here (nothing to link until it exists).

projects.name: Email autopilot
projects.why: Inbox is the biggest recurring attention tax.
projects.serves: Faster honest replies to people waiting on you.
blockers: Approval gate must exist before any send capability

projects.name: Art / music public presence
projects.why: The non-instrumental part. Feeds everything else.
projects.serves: People who need the work more than they need the systems.
projects.next_action: Pick one piece and publish it publicly this month.

projects.name: Hermes always-on monitor
projects.why: Continuity between sessions. The agent should not wake up amnesiac.
projects.serves: Demonstrates a legible always-on agent others can copy.
projects.next_action: Decide the host: local machine vs small always-on box.
